Impacted Systems: Veeam ONE IT infrastructure monitoring and analytics platform
Method of Attack: Remote code execution on SQL server hosting Veeam ONE configuration database
Acquisition of NTLM hash of account used by Veeam ONE Reporting Service via Veeam ONE Web Client access
Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attack to steal admin access token requiring user interaction
Exploitation by Read-Only User role to access Dashboard Schedule without making changes

Unprivileged user access to Veeam ONE Web Client
User interaction from Veeam ONE Administrator role
Malicious actors with Read-Only User role
